name: Attribute-specific Bit Allocation
definition: A bit allocation scheme that guides quantization based on saturation points of specific attributes to tolerate coarser quantization for less important attributes, replacing uniform allocation.
summary: Attribute-specific Bit Allocation is a lossy compression technique that assigns variable bit depths to volumetric attribute channels based on their individual sensitivity to quantization error, unlike uniform quantization which applies a single bit depth to all data.
